scripts.build: echo 'nothing to build for this package itself — the modules build via turbo ^build, from the workspace deps below'
scripts.dev: pnpm turbo run build --filter @store/catalog && bun ../../node_modules/.bin/prisma dev
scripts.deploy: pnpm turbo run build --filter @prisma/example-store... && ( set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; bun ../../node_modules/.bin/prisma deploy ${STORE_STACK_NAME:+--name "$STORE_STACK_NAME"} )
